# package routing

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-knx/routing"
```

Package routing sends and receives KNX telegrams with KNXnet/IP routing: ROUTING\_INDICATIONs on an IP multicast group (224.0.23.12:3671 by default), with flow control.

Safety: a Conn never forwards what it receives; it only sends what the application gives it. Outgoing indications are paced (at most one per 1/rate, default 50 per second, no bursts) and follow the flow control of KNXnet/IP routing on ROUTING\_BUSY: a pause of the frame's wait time plus a random extension that grows with the number of busy frames, then a reduced rate until that number has decayed. Telegrams with hop count 0 are not sent. With multicast loopback enabled, the Conn's own indications are recognised and not delivered back.

With [WithSecure](#func-withsecure) the Conn speaks KNX IP Secure routing: every frame is sent and received in a SECURE\_WRAPPER under the backbone key, with the synchronised multicast timer as sequence (package secure).

## Variables

```go
var DefaultIndividualAddress = knx.MustParseIndividualAddress("15.15.255")
```

DefaultIndividualAddress is the source address a Conn puts in telegrams sent with source 0.0.0: 15.15.255, the address of an unconfigured device. Routers drop telegrams from 0.0.0.

#### func (Conn) Receive

```go
func (c *Conn) Receive(ctx context.Context) (cemi.Frame, error)
```

Receive returns the next frame of a ROUTING\_INDICATION from another router.

#### func (Conn) Send

```go
func (c *Conn) Send(ctx context.Context, f cemi.Frame) error
```

Send sends a cEMI frame (an L\_Data.ind) as a ROUTING\_INDICATION; a source of 0.0.0 is replaced by the Conn's individual address. It waits for the pause after the previous indication and for the flow control of a ROUTING\_BUSY, and refuses frames with hop count 0.

### type Event

```go
	From netip.AddrPort
	// Busy is set for ROUTING_BUSY, Lost for ROUTING_LOST_MESSAGE.

	Lost *knxnetip.RoutingLostMessage
}
```

Event is something other than a telegram seen on the group.

#### func WithLoopback

```go
func WithLoopback(on bool) Option
```

WithLoopback enables multicast loopback, so that routers on the same host hear each other (default off). The Conn drops its own echoes.

#### func WithMetrics

```go
func WithMetrics(m knx.Metrics) Option
```

WithMetrics sets the metrics callbacks.

#### func WithQueueSize

```go
func WithQueueSize(n int) Option
```

WithQueueSize bounds the inbound queue (default 256).

#### func WithRate

```go
func WithRate(n int) Option
```

WithRate bounds the indications sent per second (default 50; 0: no limit): consecutive indications are at least 1/n apart, and sends wait for their turn. ROUTING\_BUSY is honoured at any rate.

#### func WithSecure

```go
func WithSecure(key secure.Key, latency time.Duration) Option
```

WithSecure enables KNX IP Secure routing with the backbone key and the latency tolerance of the backbone (0: secure.DefaultLatency). Listen then synchronises the multicast timer, which takes up to about 3.3 s at the default latency when no other secure router answers.

#### func WithSerialNumber

```go
func WithSerialNumber(s [6]byte) Option
```

WithSerialNumber sets the KNX serial number sent in secure frames (default 00FA followed by four random octets).

#### func WithTTL

```go
func WithTTL(ttl int) Option
```

WithTTL sets the multicast TTL (default 16).
